brief: Drive CodeBot in the simulator, in a few minutes.
complete: **You coded a robot!** Every block you used is a line of Python, and the Python is what CodeBot runs. Want to see it?

missions.title: Drive CodeBot
missions.brief: Run a program, change it, run it again.

flow.title: Drive CodeBot
flow.promise: Meet CodeBot, a robot you code with blocks. In a few steps you will make it drive and light up, right here on screen.

chapters.title: Drive
chapters.code:
from botcore import *
import time

motors.enable(True)

motors.run(LEFT, 50)
motors.run(RIGHT, 50)
time.sleep(1)
motors.run(LEFT, 0)
motors.run(RIGHT, 0)

steps.say: This is **CodeBot**, in the simulator. Drag it to look around.
These blocks are your program: they drive CodeBot forward for one second. Press **▶ Run**.
Click the **50** and make it **100**: full power.
hints: The 50 is in the orange **drive** block. Click it, type 100, then click away.

steps.say: Blocks live in the palette. Open **Lights**.
Drag **turn all top LEDs on** under your drive block.

steps.ask: Your blocks are a Python program underneath. Which line drives CodeBot?

flow.complete: CodeBot drove at full power and lit up, all from your blocks.
